text:
Anika: DocsBot just finished a nightly lint run and found a small cluster of orphan anchors and 6 '404' image refs under /runtime and /onboarding. Not urgent but low-hanging. Who can do a quick sweep tomorrow morning?

DocsBot: automated-scan: 6 image 404s, 9 dead anchors, 2 broken gist links. Details: /runtime/kv-cache -> anchor #cache-ttl, /onboarding/quickstart -> image /assets/quickstart-arch.png (403). Report ID: scan-2399998888.

Tom: I can take the runbook anchors first thing. Will open a single PR with all anchor fixes so QA can smoke test. :coffee:

Rahul: thanks Tom. I can batch the image rehosts onto the CDN (small S3 path change) but need a merge window because we still have the canary for the deploy job at 09:00 UTC. Can we aim for 10:30 UTC merges?

Anika: 10:30 UTC works. For the anchors, prefer non-invasive edits (move fragment IDs to match existing headers) so redirects aren't needed. If anyone wants the ripgrep list, I ran: 

```
rg "#cache-ttl|quickstart-arch.png|gist.github.com" sources/content -n || true
```

and a suggested sed for header-normalization: 

```
# convert H2 to anchor-friendly slug in-place (preview with --dry-run)
perl -0777 -pe 's/^(##\s+)([A-Za-z0-9 -]+)$/\1$2
<!-- anchor: ' . lc($2 =~ s/[^a-z0-9]+/-/gr) . ' -->/mge' -i.bak docs/*.md
```

Maya: heads-up — if you add HTML comments with anchors we should mention it in the PR body so the docs linter doesn't flag it as noise. Also ping me for CR; I'll be on call then. :+1:

Tom: plan: I'll make a small PR with 3 anchor edits (runtime/kv-cache, runtime/prefix-caching, onboarding/cli-setup) and include the rg output in the description. Rahul — if you post the S3 -> CDN rewrite diff I can coordinate the merge ordering.

Rahul: copying diffs into repo branch 'docs/image-rehost/239999'. Quick checklist: update image paths, add CDN CORS metadata in the PR, and attach a staging screenshot proving the image renders. I'll avoid touching permalinks.

Anika: perfect. Small request: add a tiny changelog entry in docs/CHANGELOG.md for auditing purposes: one-liner per file fixed.

DocsBot: note: running follow-up scan in 12h scheduled. Reply with 'ack' to defer automatic reminder.

Maya: ack — will CR after 10:30 UTC. Tom + Rahul please @mention me in the PR and include the staging screenshot link.

Tom: on it. Opening PR now with WIP label, will switch to ready once both anchor patch and Rahul's image diff are ready. :shipit:

Rahul: pushing image branch, linking in PR comment in 5m.

Anika: thanks everyone — nice quick sweep. I'll close the ticket once DocsBot's follow-up comes back clean. :tada:
